purpose: GIS Store V21 Studio integration: location maps, IDW interpolation, permanent backend boundary resolution and A4 landscape publication layouts
notes: Studio-only integration for GIS Store V21; unrelated Store, catalogue, authentication, payment and download code is unchanged.
Location-map mode clears any previous IDW result, so interpolation cannot leak into a location-map layout.
IDW remains visible in the main Studio canvas immediately after processing and is clipped to the selected study boundary.
The backend resolves permanent country, state, district and village boundaries from server/gis/boundaries without requiring customers to upload those datasets.
The customer boundary uploader is reserved for a custom GeoJSON or ZIP shapefile boundary.
The backend returns India state features for the country inset and state district features for the state inset, allowing publication-style locator maps.
A4 landscape layout keeps location maps points-only and IDW layouts interpolation-plus-points, with publication-style coordinate grid, north arrow, scale bar and editable sampling legend.
Coordinate grid uses three interior longitude/latitude labels; longitude labels sit above/below the main frame and latitude labels sit vertically outside the left/right frame.
Studio map redraw/zoom is synchronized with layer add/remove/selection without requiring a page refresh.
Camera fitting is separated from boundary rendering: asynchronous permanent boundary resolution no longer re-zooms the Studio canvas after CSV points have been fitted.
CSV point fitting uses tighter padding and allows a higher maximum zoom for compact sampling datasets; single-point datasets use a closer camera.
Custom boundary add/remove operations explicitly request a camera refit, while automatic permanent boundary loading only redraws the map.
The permanent boundary API is isolated at /api/studio/boundaries/resolve.
